traditions.WLC: הֵידָד֙ כְּ דֹרְכִ֣ים יַֽעֲנֶ֔ה
traditions.VUL: celéuma quasi calcántium concinétur
traditions.KJV: he shall give a shout , as they that tread [ the grapes ] ,

30.english_reference: against all the inhabitants of the earth .

traditions.WLC: אֶ֥ל כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָ אָֽרֶץ
traditions.VUL: advérsus omnes habitatóres terræ .
traditions.KJV: against all the inhabitants of the earth .

31.english_reference: A noise shall come [ even ] to the ends of the earth

traditions.WLC: בָּ֤א שָׁאוֹן֙ עַד קְצֵ֣ה הָ אָ֔רֶץ
traditions.VUL: Pervénit sónitus usque ad extréma terræ ,
traditions.KJV: A noise shall come [ even ] to the ends of the earth ;

31.english_reference: for the LORD hath a controversy with the nations

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י רִ֤יב לַֽ יהוָה֙ בַּ גּוֹיִ֔ם
traditions.VUL: quia iudícium Dómino cum géntibus :
traditions.KJV: for the LORD hath a controversy with the nations ,

31.english_reference: he will plead with all flesh

traditions.WLC: נִשְׁפָּ֥ט ה֖וּא לְ כָל בָּשָׂ֑ר
traditions.VUL: iudicátur ipse cum omni carne ,
traditions.KJV: he will plead with all flesh ;

31.english_reference: he will give them [ that are ] wicked to the sword

traditions.WLC: הָ רְשָׁעִ֛ים נְתָנָ֥ ם לַ חֶ֖רֶב
traditions.VUL: ímpios trádidi gládio ,
traditions.KJV: he will give them [ that are ] wicked to the sword ,

traditions.WLC: נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: dicit Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: saith the LORD .

32.english_reference: Thus saith the LORD of hosts

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת
traditions.VUL: Hæc dicit Dóminus exercítuum :
traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD of hosts ,

32.english_reference: Behold , evil shall go forth from nation to nation

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֥ה רָעָ֛ה יֹצֵ֖את מִ גּ֣וֹי אֶל גּ֑וֹי
traditions.VUL: Ecce afflíctio egrediétur de gente in gentem ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , evil shall go forth from nation to nation ,

32.english_reference: and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth

traditions.WLC: וְ סַ֣עַר גָּד֔וֹל יֵע֖וֹר מִ יַּרְכְּתֵי אָֽרֶץ
traditions.VUL: et turbo magnus egrediétur a summitátibus terræ .
traditions.KJV: and a great whirlwind shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth .

33.english_reference: And the slain of the LORD shall be at that day from [ one ] end of the earth even unto the [ other ] end of the earth

traditions.WLC: וְ הָי֞וּ חַֽלְלֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ בַּ יּ֣וֹם הַ ה֔וּא מִ קְצֵ֥ה הָ אָ֖רֶץ וְ עַד קְצֵ֣ה הָ אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.VUL: Et erunt interfécti Dómini in die illa , a summo terræ usque ad summum eius :
traditions.KJV: And the slain of the LORD shall be at that day from [ one ] end of the earth even unto the [ other ] end of the earth :

33.english_reference: they shall not be lamented , neither gathered , nor buried

traditions.WLC: לֹ֣א יִסָּפְד֗וּ וְ לֹ֤א יֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ וְ לֹ֣א יִקָּבֵ֔רוּ
traditions.VUL: non plangéntur , et non colligéntur , neque sepeliéntur :
traditions.KJV: they shall not be lamented , neither gathered , nor buried ;

33.english_reference: they shall be dung upon the ground

traditions.WLC: לְ דֹ֛מֶן עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ אֲדָמָ֖ה יִֽהְיֽוּ
traditions.VUL: in sterquilínium super fáciem terræ iacébunt .
traditions.KJV: they shall be dung upon the ground .

traditions.WLC: הֵילִ֨ילוּ הָ רֹעִ֜ים וְ זַעֲק֗וּ
traditions.VUL: Ululáte pastóres , et clamáte ,
traditions.KJV: Howl , ye shepherds , and cry ;

34.english_reference: and wallow yourselves [ in the ashes ] , ye principal of the flock

traditions.WLC: וְ הִֽתְפַּלְּשׁוּ֙ אַדִּירֵ֣י הַ צֹּ֔אן
traditions.VUL: et aspérgite vos cínere , optimátes gregis :
traditions.KJV: and wallow yourselves [ in the ashes ] , ye principal of the flock :

34.english_reference: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי מָלְא֥וּ יְמֵי כֶ֖ם לִ טְב֑וֹחַ וּ תְפוֹצ֣וֹתִי כֶ֔ם
traditions.VUL: quia compléti sunt dies vestri ut interficiámini , et dissipatiónes vestræ ,
traditions.KJV: for the days of your slaughter and of your dispersions are accomplished ;

34.english_reference: and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel

traditions.WLC: וּ נְפַלְתֶּ֖ם כִּ כְלִ֥י חֶמְדָּֽה
traditions.VUL: et cadétis quasi vasa pretiósa .
traditions.KJV: and ye shall fall like a pleasant vessel .

35.english_reference: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee

traditions.WLC: וְ אָבַ֥ד מָנ֖וֹס מִן הָֽ רֹעִ֑ים
traditions.VUL: Et períbit fuga a pastóribus ,
traditions.KJV: And the shepherds shall have no way to flee ,

35.english_reference: nor the principal of the flock to escape

traditions.WLC: וּ פְלֵיטָ֖ה מֵ אַדִּירֵ֥י הַ צֹּֽאן
traditions.VUL: et salvátio ab optimátibus gregis .
traditions.KJV: nor the principal of the flock to escape .

36.english_reference: A voice of the cry of the shepherds , and an howling of the principal of the flock , [ shall be heard ]

traditions.WLC: ק֚וֹל צַעֲקַ֣ת הָֽ רֹעִ֔ים וִֽ ילְלַ֖ת אַדִּירֵ֣י הַ צֹּ֑אן
traditions.VUL: Vox clamóris pastórum , et ululátus optimátum gregis :
traditions.KJV: A voice of the cry of the shepherds , and an howling of the principal of the flock , [ shall be heard ] :

36.english_reference: for the LORD hath spoiled their pasture

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי שֹׁדֵ֥ד יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מַרְעִיתָֽ ם
traditions.VUL: quia vastávit Dóminus páscua eórum .
traditions.KJV: for the LORD hath spoiled their pasture .

37.english_reference: And the peaceable habitations are cut down

traditions.WLC: וְ נָדַ֖מּוּ נְא֣וֹת הַ שָּׁל֑וֹם
traditions.VUL: Et conticuérunt arva pacis
traditions.KJV: And the peaceable habitations are cut down

37.english_reference: because of the fierce anger of the LORD

traditions.WLC: מִ פְּנֵ֖י חֲר֥וֹן אַף יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: a fácie iræ furóris Dómini .
traditions.KJV: because of the fierce anger of the LORD .

38.english_reference: He hath forsaken his covert , as the lion

traditions.WLC: עָזַ֥ב כַּ כְּפִ֖יר סֻכּ֑ וֹ
traditions.VUL: Derelíquit quasi leo umbráculum suum ,
traditions.KJV: He hath forsaken his covert , as the lion :

38.english_reference: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי הָיְתָ֤ה אַרְצָ ם֙ לְ שַׁמָּ֔ה מִ פְּנֵי֙ חֲר֣וֹן הַ יּוֹנָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: quia facta est terra eórum in desolatiónem a fácie iræ colúmbæ ,
traditions.KJV: for their land is desolate because of the fierceness of the oppressor ,

38.english_reference: and because of his fierce anger

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ פְּנֵ֖י חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽ וֹ
traditions.VUL: et a fácie iræ furóris Dómini .
traditions.KJV: and because of his fierce anger .
